scenario.opening_question: What dessert should we make our regular treat for Sunday family lunches considering taste, prep time, and everyone’s preferences?

options.name: Classic Homemade Apple Pie
options.upside: Warm, comforting flavor that appeals to most ages
options.tradeoff: Requires oven time and some baking skill
options.concern: Some family members dislike cinnamon or cooked fruit textures
options.best_for: those valuing tradition and a home-baked feel

options.name: No-Bake Chocolate Cheesecake
options.upside: Rich and creamy with minimal oven use
options.tradeoff: Needs refrigeration for several hours before serving
options.concern: May be too rich or heavy for some tastes
options.best_for: those wanting quick prep and indulgent flavor

options.name: Lemon Blueberry Pound Cake
options.upside: Light, fruity, and slightly tangy with extra servings
options.tradeoff: Longer baking time and requires cooling before serving
options.concern: Some may find it less sweet or too citrusy
options.best_for: those preferring fresh fruit flavors and extra portions

options.name: Mixed Berry Greek Yogurt Parfaits
options.upside: Healthy, customizable, and no baking required
options.tradeoff: Less traditional dessert feel and requires fresh ingredients weekly
options.concern: Some family members may want a more indulgent dessert
options.best_for: those prioritizing health and quick assembly
